name: Cupriferous-Terminus
description: Everything on this world is mid-formation: cones rising, calderas collapsing, new land cooling to black glass. The terrain gathers itself around geothermal vent fields, and by night the whole horizon pulses like a banked furnace.
The air carries burnt sugar and sulfur, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts.
The oldest impact basin predates the system's estimated age by a comfortable margin. The survey bureau has quietly stopped publishing the numbers.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on exotic matter, titanium, dark crystals and uranium are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
